configuredForm.title: Configuration-driven form
configuredForm.description: One schema and one model for editing and reading, with conditional fields, nested details and repeatable contacts.
configuredForm.sourceNote: Code and JSON use the same configuration without a backend request. Completed input saves on this device and is retained when switching source or language.
configuredForm.name: Name
configuredForm.notesHint: Shown and required when external contact is enabled.
configuredForm.addressHint: Grouped fields are stored as a nested object.
configuredForm.invalidValue: Check the format or range of this value
formShowcase.basicsPurpose: From input controls to model values, see one configuration drive the entire form.
formShowcase.basicsTry: Enter text, dates and numbers, toggle the switch, and select multiple tags. See the actual values alongside the form. Code and JSON use the same schema and keep completed input when switching.
formShowcase.detailPurpose: One configuration, two presentations. Edit with controls and read with clear formatting.
formShowcase.detailTry: Read labels resolved by selected IDs, then switch to editing. Open category or tags to search and browse one-item pages. Selections stay visible across pages; the code remains read-only.
formShowcase.detailBoundary: Local query and selected-ID functions make no network requests. Input is saved only in this browser. Opening a selector queries a page; reading mode resolves selected labels only. Mode controls presentation, not authorization.
formShowcase.dependenciesPurpose: Let one choice change another field’s options, visibility and editability.
formShowcase.dependenciesTry: Change region to reload locations, or choose an unconfigured region for an empty list. Enable contact to reveal a required email; lock notes to prevent editing. Existing location values are not cleared automatically.
formShowcase.dependenciesBoundary: locations is a complete-list local option function, without an API request. dependsOn reloads options. Hidden and disabled fields preserve their values.
formShowcase.structurePurpose: Organize nested information as objects and manage reorderable contacts as an array.
formShowcase.structureTry: Insert, duplicate, add, remove or reorder contacts. “Validate a row” checks one contact; “Validate” checks all. Each email switch affects its row. Load 0 or 4 rows to check count rules.
formShowcase.validationPurpose: Check real formats, ranges and cross-row rules, locate problems and correct them.
formShowcase.validationTry: Fill invalid values and select “Validate current data”. Name length, email format, capacity range, identifier format and duplicate emails each produce real issues. Select a field issue to focus its input.
formShowcase.extensionPurpose: Connect your own input to the same field bindings, model and detail presentation.
formShowcase.extensionTry: Add whitespace around the identifier, then leave the input or explicitly validate to trim it. Clear it and validate for the required error, then switch to reading for the prefixed detail.
formShowcase.extensionBoundary: Trusted frontend slots provide the control and detail renderer through public value, setValue, blur, focus and commit bindings. Explicit validation checks current control input without calling submit or changing the reset baseline.
formShowcase.aiRequest: Implement the requested form capability using this example in the current project:
formShowcase.aiBoundary: Use public {'@'}platform/ui APIs, PAVP design tokens and localization. Configuration is data; callbacks, sources and custom components belong in trusted frontend code. Do not introduce another form framework. Example schema:
formShowcase.groupLayoutHint: Each group takes one column and stacks naturally on a narrow screen.
formShowcase.repeatHint: Keep 1–3 contacts. Each email switch affects only its own row.
formShowcase.capacityRule: Accepts 1–8; out-of-range values receive validation feedback.
formShowcase.aliasRule: Start with a lowercase letter. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
formShowcase.extensionHint: Try a custom identifier, then read the result with its display prefix.
formShowcase.capabilitiesHint: Explore configuration, reading, dependencies, groups, validation, autosave, async options, extensions and visual building.
formShowcase.structureBoundary: Row checks commit only that row and preserve outside feedback. The validation callback still receives all values; only errors assigned inside the row publish. Global errors and parent counts require full validation. Duplication copies canonical values and preserves business IDs.
formShowcase.localBoundary: These examples do not call a business save endpoint.
formShowcase.checkInvalid: Fields need attention. Select an issue to focus.
formShowcase.noFields: There are no fields in the current model.
formShowcase.localOptionSource: Local option function, no network request
formShowcase.duplicateEmail: Emails must be unique within the contact list.

formBuilder.aiRequest: Use PAVP UiForm, useUiForm, and parseUiFormSchema to integrate the following form configuration. Preserve field types, defaults, validation, option value types, groups, and conditions.
formBuilder.aiBoundary: This JSON is UiFormSchema data. It contains no business API, save implementation, permissions, or persistence. Validate it with parseUiFormSchema before passing it to useUiForm; rebuild the controller when the schema changes. Follow the repository form-guide.md for UiFormCopy and implement any required business behavior separately in trusted frontend code.
formBuilder.importInvalid: Invalid configuration. Your current content is unchanged.
formBuilder.importUnsupported: This configuration uses features the editor cannot yet edit. Nothing was changed.
formBuilder.importFailed: Could not read the file. Try again.
formBuilder.importTooLarge: The configuration file exceeds the size limit.
formBuilder.importConfirmHint: Importing replaces the current configuration and unfinished property input.
formBuilder.restoredPending: Unfinished input restored. You can continue editing.
formBuilder.draftUnavailable: Local saving is unavailable. Export your configuration first.
formBuilder.draftInvalid: The draft could not be read. Its stored data was preserved.
formBuilder.draftExpired: This draft has expired. Its stored data was preserved.
formBuilder.draftIncompatible: This draft is incompatible with the current configuration. Its stored data was preserved.
formBuilder.draftConflict: Another window changed this draft. Review it before continuing.
formBuilder.importChanged: The configuration changed while reading the file. Import it again.

formDraft.sourceSwitchConfirm: Some input could not be saved automatically. Switching sources may lose it. Continue?
formBuilder.compositionNotSaved: Text being composed by the input method is not saved until composition finishes. Autosave then resumes.

formBuilder.previewPendingHint: Unfinished input is preserved. Complete or correct it before switching to read-only.

formBuilder.structurePending: Finish the current input before changing condition structure.
formLifecycle.purpose: Input saves automatically and is restored when you return.
formLifecycle.try: Edit any field, then refresh or switch away and return to continue.
formLifecycle.boundary: The app explicitly scopes automatic local saving to a form, record and field policy. Unfinished input remains protected. Storage errors, conflicts and expiry are not reported as saved.
formOptions.purpose: Keep selected teams while searching or paging, then switch to read mode to review your choices.
formOptions.try: Search and select teams on another page, then switch to read mode. Try another term when nothing matches. Turn catalog reading off and retry to see an error, then turn it on and retry to recover.
formOptions.boundary: A local catalog implements the paged source contract. No server is connected. The application owns transport and authentication; JSON only names a trusted frontend source.
formOptions.localHint: Choose from six local teams, two per page. Selected teams keep their names even when they are on another page. No internet connection is needed.
formOptions.recoveryNeeded: Some options are unavailable. Enable reading and retry.
formShowcase.livePendingHint: Unfinished inputs retain their last accepted values here. Finish them to update and copy the data.
formLifecycle.ready: Changes save automatically on this device
formLifecycle.notSaved: Not saved. Copy your data before leaving.
formLifecycle.unavailable: Local saving is unavailable. Copy your data first.
formLifecycle.invalidDraft: The saved record could not be restored safely and was kept. Copy your current data.
formLifecycle.expiredDraft: The saved record has expired and was kept. Copy your current data.
formLifecycle.conflict: Another page changed the saved data. Nothing was overwritten. Copy your current data.
formLifecycle.pending: Finish the current input before leaving.
formLifecycle.editHint: Name, capacity, type and notes are kept for seven days in this browser. Refresh or return later without saving or restoring manually.

tableShowcase.searchHint: Enter a name and apply the search
tableShowcase.confirmRemove: Delete this demo record? Only the current in-memory data will change.

tableExamples.tablesHint: Explore existing UiTable capabilities by layout, data interaction and configuration.
tableExamples.combinationsHint: Connect forms and tables for filtering, validation, editing and returning to a list.
tableExamples.confirmBatch: Delete only selected records from this in-memory example. Count:
tableExamples.pendingFilters: Filters are not applied yet. Results still use:
tableExamples.configBoundary: Configure local columns, selection, pagination, height and appearance. Keep rowKey as id; use Combinations for queries and editors. Applying opens the preview and rebuilds this example data.
tableExamples.aiRequest: Implement the following behavior with existing public PAVP components, tokens and request boundaries. Do not imply persistence. Interaction requirements, source locations and the applied schema follow.
tableExamples.basics.step1: Switch Auto, Fixed and Fill to compare height and scrolling.
tableExamples.basics.step2: Adjust the fixed body height, page size or empty state.
tableExamples.basics.step3: Open the last page and verify stable pagination in Fixed and Fill modes.
tableExamples.basics.boundary: UiTable height can be configured directly or in the JSON schema. Fill requires an allocated parent height.
tableExamples.columns.step1: Explore grouped headers and sort individual columns.
tableExamples.columns.step2: Hide or move columns: groups adapt and preferences survive reload.
tableExamples.columns.step3: Reset columns to restore this example’s initial arrangement.
tableExamples.columns.boundary: Groups follow column order and split across pinned areas or noncontiguous members. Order and visibility are saved locally; reset clears them.
tableExamples.selection.step1: Select individual rows or the current page and check the count.
tableExamples.selection.step2: Clear the selection or confirm deletion of the selected records.
tableExamples.selection.step3: Change page, sort or refresh and inspect the valid selection.
tableExamples.selection.boundary: Selection covers only the current page and clears on paging, sorting or querying. Deletion changes this in-memory instance only.
tableExamples.remote.step1: Wait for the live API to return products and the total.
tableExamples.remote.step2: Change pages and expand Current state to inspect the request range.
tableExamples.remote.step3: Refresh the request, or use Retry in the same place after a failure.
tableExamples.remote.boundary: Reads DummyJSON directly. Network failures remain visible with retry. This example does not provide remote sorting or writes.
tableExamples.configuration.step1: Change column titles, widths, pageSize, height or appearance, then apply to preview the table.
tableExamples.configuration.step2: Apply valid JSON and inspect the preview. Invalid input leaves the existing table intact.
tableExamples.configuration.step3: Discard unapplied changes or copy the schema for reuse.
tableExamples.configuration.boundary: parseUiTableSchema validates the configuration before rebuilding the local table. Editing JSON does not save it to a server.
tableExamples.query.step1: Enter a name and choose a category. Draft changes do not change the current results.
tableExamples.query.step2: Submit the query to apply the form values to the table together.
tableExamples.query.step3: Try a filter with no matches, then reset to restore all records.
tableExamples.query.boundary: UiForm owns the filter draft. useUiTableQuery applies it and returns to page one. Filters are in-memory, not simulated API calls.
tableExamples.modal.step1: Create a record or edit any existing row.
tableExamples.modal.step2: Submit with an empty required name to see validation and recovery.
tableExamples.modal.step3: Save and verify the changed row, then try closing with unsaved edits.
tableExamples.modal.boundary: Saving immediately updates the demo list. Keep editing or discard unsaved changes. Changes last only for this browser session.
tableExamples.drawer.step1: Open the drawer from a row while retaining the list in the background.
tableExamples.drawer.step2: Change a name, price or stock and save it back to the list.
tableExamples.drawer.step3: View read-only details. Keep editing or discard changes when canceling.
tableExamples.drawer.boundary: The drawer retains list context and shares demo records with modal and page editing. Saving updates local memory only.
tableExamples.page.step1: Open details, edit or create from the list.
tableExamples.page.step2: Complete, validate and save the form on its own page.
tableExamples.page.step3: Return to the changed list while retaining filters, page and reading position.
tableExamples.page.boundary: Uses the same in-memory demo records as modal and drawer editing. Saving updates the list; a browser reload restores the samples. No server writes.
tableShowcase.recordMissing: This demo record no longer exists. Return to the list and choose another record.
tableExamples.height.label: Table height
tableExamples.height.autoHint: Grows with content. Change the page size or empty state to compare heights.
tableExamples.height.fixedHint: Keeps the configured body height. More rows scroll inside; pagination stays in place.
tableExamples.height.fillHint: Fills the remaining panel space. Resize or change page size; headers and pagination stay visible.
tableExamples.appearance.step1: Compare no outer border, outer border, horizontal dividers, vertical dividers, grid and striped tables side by side.
tableExamples.appearance.step2: Continue to three header tones and three densities. Every specimen uses the same data.
tableExamples.appearance.step3: Copy any specimen for AI to get that table’s actual configuration.
tableExamples.appearance.boundary: Use UiTable with useUiTable and style it through schema.appearance. Omit density to follow the global setting. PAVP owns all theme colors.
tableExamples.theme.step1: Compare neutral, soft and bold themed headers for hierarchy and readability.
tableExamples.theme.step2: Select rows on the current page and inspect the themed selection, hover and category tags.
tableExamples.theme.step3: Switch themes and light or dark mode in global appearance settings. The entire table should follow.
tableExamples.theme.boundary: This page controls only appearance.headerTone. The shared PAVP theme owns all colors, with no separate theme state. Selection covers the current page and clears on paging or sorting.
tableGallery.structureHint: Six base styles retain the native header divider and follow global density.
tableGallery.headersHint: Neutral, soft and bold headers, all following global density.
tableGallery.densityHint: Cell spacing changes; text size stays the same.
tableExamples.summary.richCopy: Use a frontend summaryCell slot: themed tags for title/category, bordered themed tags for numbers, and text as the fallback. JSON describes data and calculations only.
tableCapabilities.overview.unsupported: UiTable does not yet expose grouped headers, multi-column sorting, custom comparators, drag resizing, min/max width policies, inline editing, CSV export, infinite append, persisted columns or table fullscreen. These examples only demonstrate supported interfaces.
tableCapabilities.overview.copy: Use these actual capabilities and existing UiTable interfaces. Do not invent APIs from CCD that have not been implemented.
tableCapabilities.selection.hint: Selection is limited to the current page and clears on paging, sorting or filtering. Batch deletion affects only this in-memory example.
tableCapabilities.summary.step1: Choose text, values or aggregates per column, add a second row and toggle rich rendering.
tableCapabilities.summary.step2: Switch between current-page and filtered-local scopes, then paginate to compare.
tableCapabilities.summary.step3: Scroll, hide or reorder columns and compare the aligned footer.
tableCapabilities.summary.boundary: Local aggregates use supplied records only. Remote grand totals must come from the server response. Rich content uses summaryCell.
tableCapabilities.layout.scrollHint: Scroll the middle columns horizontally and compare the pinned edges. You can also unpin either edge.
tableCapabilities.layout.widthsHint: Numeric mode: adjustable title, 500px description. Automatic mode: both widths unset. Apply changes to compare.
tableCapabilities.layout.responsiveHint: Switch container widths to inspect local table scrolling, wrapping pagination and fill height. Every column remains accessible.
tableCapabilities.layout.scrollBoundary: Pinned columns use columns.fixed. Horizontal scrolling stays inside the table, not the outer page.
tableCapabilities.layout.widthsBoundary: Numeric columns scroll horizontally when wider than the container. Omitting both widths uses native table allocation. Automatic minimum/maximum column widths and drag resizing are not exposed.
tableCapabilities.layout.responsiveBound: This is application-level container adaptation using existing layout tokens and height: fill. It does not automatically hide columns or switch to cards.
tableCapabilities.layout.copyInstruction: Implement this layout with the following public UiTable configuration. Preserve the effective column order, visibility and pinned settings.
tableCapabilities.layout.longDescription: Sample content for column width and wrapping. Changing the container width redistributes the text within the cell; the table owns any horizontal overflow.
tableCapabilities.data.sortingHint: Sort from a column header and compare submit with change queries. Changing mode or delay resets this demo.
tableCapabilities.data.renderingHint: Text, number, boolean, date, tag, nested fields and long content in one table.
tableCapabilities.data.virtualHint: 2,000 deterministic local records on one page. Toggle virtual scrolling to compare.
tableCapabilities.data.statesHint: Local request simulation, without network calls. Errors occur once so retry can recover; a new request cancels a slow one.
tableCapabilities.data.virtualBoundary: Uses fill height. The toggle changes row rendering only; this is not a performance measurement.
tableCapabilities.data.renderingBoundary: Zero and missing values remain distinct. Dates preserve their supplied date or offset. Custom actions use the rowActions slot.
tableCapabilities.data.renderingSlot: rowActions receives row. The detail button opens a dialog for that record. UiTable has no arbitrary cell slot.
tableCapabilities.data.simulatedFailure: The local simulated request failed. Retry to recover.
tableCapabilities.data.detailSource: Reads this row’s local data. No detail request is made.
tableCapabilities.data.longSample: This local record checks natural wrapping of long content. The complete note is retained. On a narrow screen, scroll the table horizontally or open the details to read it.
tableCapabilities.data.offsetSample: The timestamp retains its +08:00 offset instead of converting to the browser time zone. The number keeps its supplied precision.
tableCapabilities.data.nullSample: This row contains actual null values. Number, boolean, date, tag and nested name use the component’s empty-value text instead of becoming zero or false.
tableCapabilities.data.transportCopy: This page uses a local asynchronous UiTableTransport with no HTTP call. source.kind is remote to exercise resolved requests, AbortSignal cancellation and response summary. The transport reads actual filter, sort, offset and page-size parameters, computes totals across all matching records, and returns them with the page; totals are not reconstructed from the current page.
tableCapabilities.data.sortingCompact: Changing mode or delay resets this demo.
formCapabilities.loading.purpose: Explore delayed hydration, retry, and refresh that preserves edited values and pending control input.
formCapabilities.loading.try: Edit the name, then refresh the current record. You can also keep editing during the 1.4-second local delay. Untouched fields and the reset baseline update while your edits remain.
formCapabilities.loading.boundary: Two in-memory sample records and a local delay only. No service connection or persistent storage.
formCapabilities.loading.pendingHint: Try an unfinished number, then refresh. Pending control input is protected too.
formCapabilities.loading.switchBlocked: Unsaved edits block record switching. To discard them, finish any pending input and reset first. Refreshing the current record still preserves edits.
formCapabilities.loading.resetHint: A successful load updates this baseline. Reset discards local edits and restores these values, rather than the first record shown on entry.
formCapabilities.loading.interrupted: The local load was stopped when you left this page. Your edits remain; refresh to try again.
formCapabilities.loading.state.idle: Ready: refresh or switch the example record.
formCapabilities.loading.state.loading: Waiting for local hydration. You can still edit the form…
formCapabilities.loading.state.ready: Loaded: untouched fields updated and existing edits preserved.
formCapabilities.loading.state.failed: The simulated local load failed. Existing values remain; retry loading to recover.
formCapabilities.loading.state.blocked: Record switch blocked: unsaved input appeared during loading. Keep editing, or finish pending input and reset before switching.
formCapabilities.submission.purpose: Explore native form submission, awaited results, field and form failures, retry, and normalized hydration.
formCapabilities.submission.try: Choose a success or failure scenario, then run the local submission or press Enter in a single-line field. Repeated clicks while busy do not increase the execution count. After a failure, select success and submit again to retry.
formCapabilities.submission.boundary: Results are simulated in page memory only, with no backend save. Success replaces the reset baseline; results do not survive closing the page.
formCapabilities.submission.normalizeHin: Success trims the name and lowercases the email address.
formCapabilities.submission.succeeded: Local submission finished. Normalized values are now the reset baseline; nothing was saved to a server.
formCapabilities.submission.failed: The local simulation failed. Input is preserved; choose the success scenario and retry.
formCapabilities.submission.fieldFailed: Simulated field validation failed. Review the alias error, choose success, and retry.
formCapabilities.submission.aliasRejecte: Simulated result: this alias is unavailable. You can edit it and switch to the success scenario to retry.
formCapabilities.submission.formRejected: Simulated result: this submission cannot be processed right now. Keep your input and choose success to retry.
formCapabilities.submission.interrupted: Local submission stopped when you left the page. No result was accepted; submit again when you return.
formCapabilities.submission.ready: Ready: submission waits 1.4 seconds and runs only in this page’s memory.
formCapabilities.calculations.hint: Live plan, quantity and discount totals
formCapabilities.calculations.purpose: Drive a practical quote preview directly from real form values.
formCapabilities.calculations.try: Change the plan, quantity and discount, then clear a required number to see how the preview responds.
formCapabilities.calculations.boundary: Page-owned computed derives the quote from form.values without writing back. JSON formulas are not executed. This is a frontend demo; a server must confirm actual prices.
formCapabilities.calculations.intro: Choose a plan and seat count to preview the discounted monthly quote. All amounts are in CNY.
formCapabilities.calculations.invalid: Enter a valid plan, 1–1000 whole seats and a 0–100% discount. Incomplete input does not produce an estimate.
formCapabilities.calculations.rounding: Calculated in cents. Discount is rounded to the nearest cent before subtraction. Excludes tax; not an order or payment commitment.
formCapabilities.layout.hint: One column, two columns and nested groups
formCapabilities.layout.purpose: Explore UiForm columns, full-width fields and nested groups with one shared input state.
formCapabilities.layout.try: Fill in a project and contact, switch columns, then narrow the window to see the automatic reflow.
formCapabilities.layout.boundary: UiForm columns changes presentation; schema span and group define structure. The controller is not recreated and input state is not duplicated.
formCapabilities.layout.intro: Fill in the form, then switch layouts. Long text spans the full row; delivery and contact details stay grouped.
formCapabilities.layout.fullSpanHint: span: 2 gives long text the full row in the two-column layout.
formCapabilities.layout.groupHint: Grouped fields inherit the current columns. Contact details are nested within delivery.
formCapabilities.layout.responsive: Two columns is the wide-screen preference. Existing layout breakpoints automatically reflow narrow screens to one column.
formCapabilities.layout.preserved: Only columns changes. The form stays mounted, preserving entered values, validation state and undo history.
formCapabilities.calculations.integerErr: Seat count must be a whole number.
formCapabilities.overview.copy: Build this form with public PAVP UiForm capabilities, preserving shared themes, local scrolling, fixed actions and existing components.
formCapabilities.overview.boundary: Calculations and custom controls are trusted frontend compositions. Loading and submission examples are local simulations, not backend integrations.
formCapabilities.controls.hint: Connect card and checkbox choices directly to form state.
formCapabilities.controls.purpose: Choose controls suited to preferences while preserving validation, details, reset and undo.
formCapabilities.controls.try: Change the reminder card and delivery channels, disable notifications, then inspect the detail view.
formCapabilities.controls.boundary: Preferences are demonstrated in page memory only. System notification settings are unchanged.
formCapabilities.controls.profileHint: Cards write one field. Use arrow keys to change the selected choice.
formCapabilities.controls.channelsHint: Choose at least one channel when enabled. Disabling preserves your selection.
chartExamples.trendDescription: Follow two continuous series across 96 hourly samples. Update the data to see the curves move smoothly.
chartExamples.comparisonDescription: Compare monthly performance and update data to see the transition.
chartExamples.compositionDescription: Explore the share of each category. Hover to focus.
chartExamples.distributionDescription: Compare investment and return. Bubble size represents sample size.
chartExamples.heatmapDescription: Darker cells indicate more activity. Hover for each time slot.
chartExamples.rankingDescription: Update the data to see bars move with their ranking.
chartExamples.error: The chart could not be rendered. Please try again.
chartExamples.copyRequest: Use this example to build a chart with PAVP UiG2Chart. Reuse the existing theme, sizing and motion settings without adding another configuration system.
showcase.category.charts: Trends, comparisons, shares, distribution and interaction.
chartExamples.stackedAreaDescription: Follow each channel’s contribution and the changing total across four days of hourly samples.
chartExamples.stepDescription: Show changes in discrete steps and inspect individual points.
chartExamples.stackedBarsDescription: Compare monthly totals and each channel’s contribution.
chartExamples.pieDescription: Compare each category’s share. Hover to focus on one.
chartExamples.roseDescription: Compare categories by radial length and hover for exact values.
chartExamples.scatterDescription: Explore investment and return across individual samples.
chartExamples.sliderDescription: Explore four days of hourly samples in the overview. Drag the window to pan or either handle to resize the range.
chartExamples.brushDescription: Brush horizontally over the plot to sync the timeline. Double-click the plot to reset. Click the chart, then scroll to zoom.
chartExamples.timelineDescription: Watch four successive rankings with time to follow each move. Replay, update, or skip to the final frame.
chartExamples.trendsSummary: Smooth lines, stacked areas and discrete step changes.
chartExamples.comparisonSummary: Grouped comparisons, stacked totals and dynamic ranking.
chartExamples.compositionSummary: Donut, pie and rose charts for shares and structure.
chartExamples.distributionSummary: Bubbles, points and heatmaps reveal relationships.
chartExamples.interactionSummary: Sliders, brushing and finite timelines that you can operate.
chartExamples.rangeHint: Drag handles to resize or the window to pan. Click the timeline, then scroll to zoom; Shift + scroll pans. Alt + scroll works directly. Arrow keys fine-tune, Home / End reach boundaries, Esc cancels a drag.
chartExamples.plotRangeHint: Time-range chart. Click, then scroll to zoom; Shift + scroll pans. Scrolling otherwise moves the page.
chartLive.streamDescription: Three simulated signals stream into a rolling 36-second window. Watch new samples arrive and older samples leave.
chartLive.rankingDescription: Six regions reorder by their current rate. Stable category colors help you follow changing bar lengths and ranks.
chartLive.distributionDescription: A rolling set of 120 simulated latency samples, grouped into 100 ms bins. Each frame replaces six samples and updates the mean and P95.
chartLive.streamMethod: Periodic signals generate three series. Each frame advances one simulated second. The vertical scale stays at 0–160 events/s to avoid misleading rescaling. Reset reproduces the same data.
chartLive.rankingMethod: Continuous signals generate rates for six fixed regions, sorted each frame. Stable keys preserve bar identity, with a fixed 0–160 value range. Reset returns to the same first frame.
chartLive.distributionMethod: A repeatable signal generates 120 samples. Bins include their lower bound and exclude their upper bound; P95 is the 114th sorted sample. Six oldest samples are replaced per frame; the count scale stays at 0–80.
chartLive.lifecycle: Each frame represents one simulated second; frequency only changes playback speed. Inspecting data pauses updates. Inactive pages stop ticking and never catch up on missed frames. Chart transitions follow platform motion settings.
apiShowcase.initial: Send a request to inspect its result here.
apiShowcase.quickHint: Switch IDs quickly. Previous requests are cancelled; only the latest result is shown.
apiShowcase.timeoutHint: The standard timeout is 10 seconds. Time is measured; cancellation only ends the client wait.
apiShowcase.localHint: Local Responses pass through the real client. No server is contacted and nothing is saved.
apiShowcase.publicHint: Public services are read-only. Failures remain visible without simulated fallback.
apiShowcase.timeHint: World time uses the current API configuration and displays a response snapshot.
apiShowcase.unconfigured: The project API is not configured; world time is unavailable.
apiShowcase.schemaHint: Data is valid only after MIME, parsing and schema validation pass.
apiShowcase.errorHint: No automatic retries. Inputs and last valid data are retained; 429 may include Retry-After.
apiShowcase.authHint: Demo authorization is injected locally. No real credentials or login system are involved.
apiShowcase.copyIntro: Implement this use case with existing PAVP APIs, themes, sizing, scrolling and lifecycle ownership.
apiShowcase.copyBoundary: Reuse createApiClient. Cancel requests when stopped or deactivated and prevent stale results. Use sample data only; local tests do not contact a server or persist. This copy includes no credentials or raw upstream data.
apiShowcase.queryHint: Anonymous GET JSON. Data is immediately stale; unused cache is collected after 5 minutes. No automatic refresh, retry or persistence.
apiShowcase.integrationHint: Filters, pagination and details read public products without submitting changes.
apiShowcase.scenario.head: HEAD · no body
apiShowcase.error.network: Could not connect to the service
apiShowcase.error.http: The service returned an error status
apiShowcase.error.protocol: Response type or size violates the contract
apiShowcase.error.parse: Response body could not be parsed
apiShowcase.error.schema: Response fields did not pass validation
apiShowcase.error.caller-abort: Cancelled by caller, not a service failure
apiShowcase.query.empty: No successful cache for this parameter
apiShowcase.query.policy: Local scenario, no network. Concurrent consumers share one request. Data is immediately stale; unused cache is collected after 5 minutes. No automatic retries, polling, or persistence.
apiShowcase.query.loading: Visible consumers are awaiting the request…
apiShowcase.query.idle: Read manually to begin. Changing parameters or showing a panel does not trigger a request.
apiShowcase.query.success: Read complete; cache updated. Concurrent callers share one transport call.
apiShowcase.query.failure: HTTP 503: refresh failed. Previous successful cache is retained. Select a valid response and retry manually.
apiShowcase.query.accepted: HTTP 202: accepted but not complete. No success cache write; previous data is retained.
apiShowcase.query.cancelled: Waiting cancelled. Existing cache is retained.
apiShowcase.query.invalidated: Marked invalid, without a request. Refresh manually.
apiShowcase.integration.failed: Could not read details. Close and reopen to retry.
apiShowcase.advanced.hint: Customize requests and responses, collect batch results, and receive SSE and NDJSON incrementally.
apiShowcase.advanced.hooksHint: Finite local example: client hooks add default query and a safe header; request hooks trim the body. Response transformations still pass through schema validation. No custom code is evaluated.
apiShowcase.advanced.batchHint: 5 independent jobs include success, HTTP 503, and HTTP 202. Change concurrency to observe actual transport calls and peak activity. One failure does not discard other results.
apiShowcase.advanced.streamHint: A finite local stream emits an event every 450ms. Cancel or trigger an error on event 4. Received events remain visible and do not imply a complete result.
apiShowcase.advanced.batchOrder: Results preserve input order. HTTP 202 means accepted, not completed.
apiShowcase.advanced.empty: Run the example to see results here.
apiShowcase.advanced.partial: These are partial events. The stream did not complete.
tableCapabilities.data.multipleHint: Click headers in priority order. Click again to reverse or remove a sort.
tableCapabilities.data.businessHint: Ascending category order is Research → Engineering → Design. Add price or stock as secondary sorts.
tableShowcase.exportBoundary: CSV follows visible columns and their order; other pages and hidden columns are excluded.
tableInline.hint: Edit a name, price or stock, then save to update the record.
tableInline.local: Changes are saved in memory. Reloading restores the sample records.
configurationAssist.hint: Suggestions come from the runtime parser. Complete valid JSON first. Added properties start as null placeholders; fill their values before applying. Suggestions stop at the first invalid node.
showcase.intent.title: Find a combination for your task
showcase.intent.hint: Try an existing example, then copy it for your AI. Each card links to a working example.
showcase.intent.aiRequest: Reuse the following existing PAVP capabilities and configuration. Respect the example data and API boundaries: local demonstrations are not server persistence, and remote reads do not imply write endpoints.
showcase.intent.query: Set filters, then apply them together. Reset to show all records again.
showcase.intent.modal: Create or edit a record in a dialog, then return straight to the table.
showcase.intent.drawer: Keep the table in view while editing a record in a side drawer.
showcase.intent.page: Open a larger form in its own tab, then return when finished or cancelled.
showcase.intent.remote: Read a real API and try remote pagination, loading, errors and retry.
showcase.intent.localNote: Local demonstration. Changes are not saved to a server.
showcase.intent.remoteNote: Real API reads. Remote writes are not included.
